notes: The sheet, numbered 26, asks whether the subfigure order ≤ can be expressed using refinement ≪ and subdivision ≼, and places “??” in the margin. It asserts F≤G and F≼G ⇒ F=G, then proposes a reduction using a nonempty figure H disjoint from F. These statements are reported, not certified from definitions absent here. No title or date is written on the sheet.

The local reduction is propositionally consistent: assuming the asserted existence of nonempty H for strict F≤G, C5 transfers disjointness from F to G under F≼G; the displayed lemma would then give H=ϕ, a contradiction. Only this conditional structure was checked, not the existence assertion, C5, or the displayed lemma (027-check-01). The gloss reads “comp. à G”, and the inserted proof reference after G′ is now read as “par C1”, with C5/C4 alternatives. Those crops determine the readings; expected mathematics does not supply them.

C5 is justified on the page by equality of supports and the empty-intersection criterion. C6 says “on la verra tantôt”; C7 says “on le vérifiera” followed by a doubtful topologique/topologiquement-like ending. These are promises of verification. The final label has a preferred2-shaped main glyph, with8/ϕ alternatives and a distinct low0; only C is securely underlined.

Retain the unexpected “de, F” and the literal = shorthand in the opening question. The small gloss opens a parenthesis without a visible close. The conclusion’s subscript in ϕ_F is present although the later proof writes plain ϕ. The upper figure/fig. addition, cancelled proof note and several struck letters remain unresolved.

The independent audit makes the raised axiom reference after G-prime doubtful: C1 is now the preferred visible digit, with C5 and C4 retained. The earlier live prose reference to C5 is unchanged; it does not license correcting the raised reference. The lowest label is preferred as C2_0, with C8_0 and a phi-like form retained; the numerical sequence is not used to force 8. The mark before the support-intersection formula is retained as doubtful compressed par/turnstile.
